scope: The Altria Theater exterior at 6 North Laurel Street as photographed in June 2023. Includes the mapped building, brick and terracotta front, recessed pointed arch, paired slender towers, corner pavilion roof forms and main auditorium envelope. Theater interiors, temporary objects, vehicles and streets are outside the model.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The operator identifies the venue across Monroe Park, its 1927 opening, and the theater’s minarets.
The state register identifies the auditorium as part of the Monroe Park Historic District.
The exterior restoration consultant identifies textured tan, amber and rust brick, terracotta, limestone, granite, and ornamental copper.
